name: Import contacts from a CSV file
goal: A sales admin moves a list of contacts from a spreadsheet into the CRM in one session and sees how many contacts arrived.

entry_points.context: The admin has a CSV export from the old spreadsheet.

entry_points.from: Empty contacts list, link "Import from a file"
entry_points.context: First use, the list has no contacts.

prerequisites: The user is signed in with the Admin role.
The file is a CSV with a header row and at most 5,000 rows.

steps.title: Choose a file
steps.user_intent: Give the CRM the CSV file with my contacts.
information_needed: A sample file to check the layout

copy.text: Import contacts
Choose a CSV file with a header row. The maximum is 5,000 rows.
Download a sample file

steps.title: Match columns
steps.user_intent: Tell the CRM which column holds the name, the email address and the company.
information_needed: First three values of each column

copy.text: Match your columns to contact fields
Email address is required.
Do not import this column

steps.title: Check a preview
steps.user_intent: See what the first contacts look like before I import all of them.
steps.screen: Import: step 3 of 4, preview of the first 5 rows
information_needed: Number of rows with a problem

copy.text: Check your contacts
248 contacts are ready. 3 rows have a problem and will be skipped.

steps.title: Confirm the import
steps.user_intent: Start the import when I am sure the data is right.
information_needed: How many contacts will be added
That existing contacts with the same email address are updated

copy.text: Ready to import
Contacts with an email address that is already in the CRM are updated.

steps.title: Import in progress
steps.user_intent: Know that the import works and how long it takes.
information_needed: Progress as a count of contacts
That I can leave this page

copy.text: Importing your contacts
120 of 248 contacts imported

steps.title: See the result
steps.user_intent: Know what was imported and what was not.
information_needed: Number of contacts added, updated and skipped

copy.text: Import finished
245 contacts added, 3 skipped.

states.trigger: The contacts list is empty and the admin opens the import for the first time.
states.visible_feedback: A short text explains the CSV layout and offers the sample file.

copy.text: No contacts yet. Import a CSV file to get started.

states.trigger: The file is not a CSV, is empty or has more than 5,000 rows.
states.visible_feedback: An error message under the upload area names the problem and the fix. The page keeps its place.

copy.text: This file is not a CSV. Save it as CSV from your spreadsheet and try again.
This file has 6,200 rows. The maximum is 5,000. Split the file and import it in parts.

states.trigger: The admin continues without a column for the email address.
states.visible_feedback: The email address row gets an error text and focus. Other choices stay as they are.
available_actions: Pick a column for email address

copy.text: Choose the column that holds the email address.

states.trigger: The import request fails because the connection drops or the server does not answer.
states.visible_feedback: A message appears above the button. The column match and the preview stay as the admin left them.

copy.text: The import did not start. Your column match is saved. Check your connection and try again.
Retry

states.trigger: The admin presses "Import 248 contacts" twice or presses Enter again.
states.visible_feedback: The button is disabled after the first press and shows a busy label. Only one import starts.

copy.text: Starting import…

states.trigger: The import takes longer than 10 seconds.
states.visible_feedback: The progress count keeps updating. A note says the admin can leave the page and an email follows.

copy.text: Large files take a few minutes. You can leave this page. We email you when the import is done.

states.trigger: Some rows fail validation, for example an email address without an @ sign.
states.visible_feedback: The summary shows added, updated and skipped counts. A link downloads the skipped rows with a reason for each.

copy.text: 245 contacts added, 3 skipped. Download the skipped rows to see what to fix.

states.trigger: The session ends while the admin reviews the preview.
states.visible_feedback: A sign-in dialog opens. After sign-in the admin returns to the confirmation step with the column match kept.

copy.text: You were signed out. Sign in again to continue. Your import settings are saved.

states.visible_feedback: A confirmation with the counts and a link to the contacts list. The new contacts show in the list.

copy.text: Done. 248 contacts are now in your CRM.

states.trigger: The admin cancels before the import starts.
states.visible_feedback: The admin returns to the contacts page. No contacts are added. The uploaded file is deleted.

copy.text: Import cancelled. No contacts were added.

terminal_states.observable_result: The contacts list shows the imported contacts and the result page shows the counts.
The contacts list is unchanged and the uploaded file is gone.

risks.description: Rows with an existing email address could create duplicates.
risks.mitigation: Match on email address and update the existing contact. State this on the confirmation step.

risks.description: The admin maps the wrong column and imports bad data.
risks.mitigation: Show three sample values per column and a preview of the first five rows before the import.

acceptance_criteria.given: The admin is on the upload step
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose a file that is not a CSV
acceptance_criteria.then: an error under the upload area names the problem and the fix, and the admin can choose another file without reloading

acceptance_criteria.given: The admin is on the column match step
acceptance_criteria.when: they press Continue without a column for the email address
acceptance_criteria.then: focus moves to the email address row, its error text is read by a screen reader, and the other choices stay set

acceptance_criteria.given: The admin pressed "Import 248 contacts" and the network is down
acceptance_criteria.then: an error message with a Retry button shows, the column match is still set, and Retry starts one import when the network is back

acceptance_criteria.given: The admin is on the confirmation step
acceptance_criteria.when: they press "Import 248 contacts" twice in quick succession
acceptance_criteria.then: only one import starts and the contacts list has no duplicates
a screen reader announces the new count in a polite live region without moving focus

acceptance_criteria.given: 3 of 251 rows have an invalid email address
acceptance_criteria.then: the result shows 248 added and 3 skipped, and the downloaded file lists each skipped row with a reason

acceptance_criteria.given: The session expires on the confirmation step
acceptance_criteria.then: they return to the confirmation step and the column match is still set

options_considered.tradeoffs: More steps, but the admin sees the data before it is stored and can fix the match.
Faster, but a wrong guess stores bad data and the admin has no way to check it.

decisions.decision: Update an existing contact when the email address matches.
decisions.reason: Duplicates are the most common complaint about imports.
decisions.source: Assumption from the product owner, to confirm with 3 admins.

assumptions.text: Most imports have fewer than 1,000 rows.
assumptions.validation: Check the file sizes in the support tickets of the last 3 months.

open_questions: Should the import send an email when it finishes, or only show a notification?
